paragraphs: A local-first web app for Koala Sampler projects. Drop in a .koala file, pick a key on the on-screen piano, and the app tunes the right pads to it, balances their loudness, colours and labels them, routes them to buses, and lets you rearrange them. Then it exports a new .koala file ready to open in Koala. Everything runs on-device in the browser; nothing is uploaded. It installs to an iOS home screen as a PWA and works offline after the first load.
features: Drop a .koala project (or tap to choose one). Every pad's audio is read at its native sample rate and bit depth (16/24/32-bit PCM and float WAV), with no resampling on load. Stereo is preserved end to end.
Each pad is analysed on a background worker: a custom YIN pitch tracker finds the root note, and folder names alone determine the sound category; filenames and audio do not change it.
The last project, your per-pad choices and your pad arrangement are remembered between visits.

Four loaders, one per bank (menu). Each fills only its own bank, replaces what was there when loaded again (after asking) and leaves every other bank alone. Sounds are named by type and number ("Kick 1", "Snare 2", "808…
